introduction: A repository's web URL, built once in issuex.Repo and reused by IssueRef.URL.

glossary.web URL: The address of a repository's or an issue's page on its forge, as a browser opens it.

requirements.title: Repo.WebURL
requirements.rationale: A caller that wants a project's page should not repeat the host and scheme rules IssueRef.URL already holds.

criteria.condition: Repo.WebURL is called on a repository whose Host is empty
Repo.WebURL is called on a repository whose Host is set
criteria.action: return <scheme>://<host>/<Owner>/<Name>, where an http:// or https:// prefix on Host sets the scheme (https otherwise), surrounding space and a trailing slash on Host are dropped, and a nested GitLab Owner is kept whole
criteria.contract: a URL whose path is Owner + "/" + Name with no doubled slash

requirements.title: IssueRef.URL builds on Repo.WebURL
requirements.rationale: The host and scheme rules should live in one place, and no URL a tool already prints may change.

criteria.action: for any IssueRef, return from URL() exactly the string it returned before this change, built from Repo.WebURL plus the issue or pull/merge request suffix

execution_paths.title: A caller turns an origin remote into its project page

steps.action: parses the origin remote with issuex.ParseRemote
returns the Repo with its host, nested owner and name
calls WebURL on that Repo and opens the page
